bilateral_primary_records: PRC MFA July 2008 report records signature of the supplemental descriptive protocol for the eastern boundary and annex, stating the 4,300+ km boundary was demarcated and domestic ratification steps remained.
PRC MFA October 14, 2008 briefing says exchange of notes confirmed the protocol and annex entered into force that day and mentions marker unveiling.

primary_context_read.US_metadata_limit: The 2025 LSIB metadata describes most, not all, lines as within 100m; it gives no universal error guarantee. The product reflects US boundary recognition/dispute policy, not universal sovereignty or control. No special disputed label appears on the retained CHN-RUS feature.

interpretation.conclusion: A source-specific contextual treatment is defensible for the exact 8,108-key Russia-facing subset as a candidate to carry into the existing stock native qualification path. It is materially better supported than treating the 2019 illustrative CHN ADM1 boundary contact as dispositive where the retained full-resolution international line and bilateral records place those exact centers on the Russia-facing side. This is a contextual applicability statement about these retained competing source geometries, not a sovereignty finding, current legal boundary certification, or positive repair/credit.
interpretation.not_qualified_yet: No observer, native diagnostic/authority, constructor, or current-owner conservation was run here. Original source membership, all 122 complete foreign source features across six source families and 230 target-specific negative operand bindings (for 334 RUS targets), physical issues and native uniqueness must remain in the stock qualification route; physical/source issues are not cured by the side comparison. The retained physical summary has 236 adverse records across 140 of 334 targets; the 54MB target-level receipt was referenced but not materialized in this ZIP, so this review does not say whether the 32 proposed targets are individually issue-free.
interpretation.remaining_adverse_scope: Keep all 872 opposite-side CHN keys and 471 other-family keys adverse/preserved; do not apply the contextual statement to their keys or generalize it to entire provinces/municipalities. Preserve all original physical/source issues and all prior 2,557,516 accepted cells.
